_说明: 术语表（G7）：页面上这些词第一次出现时加虚下划线，悬停 / 点按显示一句话解释。按词长自动优先匹配；改措辞只改这里。

terms.def_zh: 市值 ÷ 已实现市值，也就是价格 ÷ 全网平均持币成本。1 以下 = 平均每个币都在浮亏。
terms.def_en: Market cap ÷ realized cap, i.e. price ÷ the network-wide average cost. Below 1 = the average coin is under water.

terms.def_zh: 真实市场均价：剔除长期不动的币后，活跃筹码的平均成本，常被当作牛熊分界的参考线。
terms.def_en: True Market Mean: the average cost of actively traded coins, excluding long-dormant supply; often used as a bull/bear reference line.

terms.def_zh: 累计币天销毁价值 ÷（币龄 × 600 万）。历史上价格从没收盘跌破过它，常被当作价格下限。
terms.def_en: Cumulative value-days destroyed ÷ (age × 6 million). Price has never closed below it, so it is read as a floor.

terms.def_zh: 短期持有者（STH）= 持币不满 155 天的人；短期持有者成本 = 这批币的平均买入价。
terms.def_en: Short-term holders (STH) hold coins for under 155 days; STH cost is the average buy price of those coins.

terms.def_zh: 长期持有者（LTH）= 持币超过 155 天的人；长期持有者成本 = 这批币的平均买入价。
terms.def_en: Long-term holders (LTH) hold coins for over 155 days; LTH cost is their average buy price.

terms.def_zh: 按持币时长分组（1-3 月、3-6 月、6-12 月……）算出的每组平均买入价。
terms.def_en: The average buy price of each holding-age group (1–3 months, 3–6 months, 6–12 months…).

terms.def_zh: 持有 6 个月到 10 年的币的平均成本 ÷ 10 年内全部币的平均成本。≥ 1 只在熊市够深时出现。
terms.def_en: Average cost of coins held 6 months–10 years ÷ average cost of all coins moved within 10 years. ≥ 1 only appears in deep bear markets.

terms.def_zh: 已实现市值 ÷ 供应量 = 全网每个币最后一次移动时的价格的平均值。
terms.def_en: Realized cap ÷ supply = the average price at which every coin last moved.

terms.def_zh: 交易核心稳定币（USDT、USDC、FDUSD、USD1、TUSD、USDD）剔除 Tron 链之后的量，最贴近交易所和主流链上能直接买币的钱。
terms.def_en: Trading-core stablecoins (USDT, USDC, FDUSD, USD1, TUSD, USDD) excluding Tron — the closest proxy for money ready to buy on exchanges.

terms.def_zh: L1 里的「加密资金通道」：稳定币、现货 ETF、期货升水和资金轮动矩阵。只用来确认 L1，不单独预测方向。
terms.def_en: L1's crypto funding channels: stablecoins, spot ETFs, futures basis and the rotation matrix. They only confirm L1 and never predict direction on their own.

terms.def_zh: ETF 在流入、链上稳定币在减少：钱从链上搬到 ETF，换的是通道不是人群，不是新钱进场。
terms.def_en: ETF inflows while on-chain stablecoins shrink: money moves from on-chain into ETFs — a change of pipe, not new money.

terms.def_zh: 芝加哥联储全国金融条件指数，0 以下 = 比历史平均宽松；13 周上升 = 收紧。
terms.def_en: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index; below 0 = looser than average; rising over 13 weeks = tightening.

terms.def_zh: 10 年期通胀保值国债收益率。按 13 周变化和水平分四态：急升、下行、高位平台、低位平台。
terms.def_en: The 10-year TIPS yield, split into four states by its 13-week change and level: surging, falling, high plateau, low plateau.

terms.def_zh: 纳指 13 周涨跌、VIX（取负）、通胀预期 13 周变化三项各自标准化后取平均；> 0 = 比历史平均乐观。
terms.def_en: The average of standardized Nasdaq 13-week change, −VIX and the 13-week change in breakeven inflation; > 0 = more optimistic than average.

terms.def_zh: 永续合约多空之间定期互付的费用。正 = 多头付钱给空头，越高说明多头越拥挤。
terms.def_en: The periodic payment between longs and shorts on perpetual futures. Positive = longs pay shorts; higher = more crowded longs.

terms.def_zh: 还没平仓的合约名义价值总和，7 日变化看杠杆在堆积还是在出清。
terms.def_en: The notional value of contracts still open; its 7-day change shows leverage building or flushing.

terms.def_zh: 市值前 50（剔除稳定币等）里 30 日涨幅跑赢 BTC 的币占比，本站自建口径。
terms.def_en: Share of the top-50 coins (ex stablecoins etc.) beating BTC over 30 days; this site's own construction.

terms.def_zh: 发新币的平台（如 pump.fun），本站按每天收的手续费比较它们的生意。
terms.def_en: Token-launch platforms (e.g. pump.fun); this site compares them by daily fees.

terms.def_zh: 本站用链上数据自己核算手续费和销毁的几个重点平台。
terms.def_en: Platforms whose fees and burns this site reconciles from its own on-chain data.

terms.def_zh: 比特币每约四年一次的出块奖励减半，四年周期的时间锚点。
terms.def_en: Bitcoin's block-reward cut roughly every four years — the time anchor of the four-year cycle.

辅助: 展示、帮助理解，不进判定。
Shown for context; not part of the verdict.
观察: 测过但没达到可用标准，只看不用。
Tested but not good enough; watch only.
已验证: 自有数据实测，且过了噪声 / 稳健性检验。
Measured on our own data and passed noise / robustness checks.
已验证·方向: 方向稳定，但样本小或幅度不稳。
Direction is stable, but samples are few or magnitudes unstable.
描述读数: 只描述当下所处的位置，不定参数。
Describes where things stand; sets no parameters.
监控: 规模或口径还在变，先记录。
Size or definition is still changing; recorded for now.
观察项: 测过但没达到可用标准。
假设: 机制推理，或只在部分周期成立。
Reasoned mechanism, or holds only in some cycles.
已证伪: 测过不成立；仍显示的是为了说明为什么不用。
Tested and failed; shown only to explain why it is not used.
记录中: 自录数据不满 90 天，暂不给分位。
Self-recorded for fewer than 90 days; no percentiles yet.
